image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a street scene featuring multiple signs. The primary subject is a rectangular white sign with black, nonsensical text mounted on two dark vertical posts. Above it are other signs: a partial white sign with 'SK' visible, and a circular sign with an orange abstract symbol. In the background, there is a red brick building facade with a window and a large clock face near the top.
